summary: Unitil Corporation filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 3 to its Purchase Agreement to acquire all shares of Aquarion Water Company of Massachusetts, Inc., Aquarion Water Company of New Hampshire, Inc., and Abenaki Water Co., Inc. from Aquarion Water Authority. Amendment No. 3 extends the termination date from May 25, 2026 to June 30, 2026, with all other terms unchanged. No pricing, premium, or advisor details are provided in this filing. The amendment simply adjusts the regulatory or closing timeline. The risk-arb angle is minimal; watch for regulatory clearance and definitive consummation by the new June 30 deadline.
